identity.name: Prospex 1965 Heritage Diver 39mm Black
identity.one_liner: The 2023 Prospex 1965 Heritage Diver 39mm with the new 6R55 movement — 70-hour reserve, hi-beat 21,600 vph, the most-cited Asian mid-tier diver at $1,500.

provenance_events.description: Seiko releases the SPB451 as the 39mm 1965 Heritage Diver with the new 6R55 movement — 70-hour reserve, hi-beat 21,600 vph.

narrative.story: The SPB451 is the 2023 addition to the Prospex 1965 Heritage line — 39mm steel, ceramic bezel, sapphire crystal, the new 6R55 movement (70-hour reserve, hi-beat 21,600 vph).
narrative.collector_notes: The 6R55 is one of the most-cited mid-tier Seiko movements of the 2020s — 70-hour reserve, hi-beat 21,600 vph, free-sprung balance.
